acquisition.release: USFM export dated 2026-03-08 inside the zip; tables and text files fetched the same day
acquisition.fetched_by: b003 agent (Claude Fable 5.1) for the source steward
acquisition.method: curl -sSL of bsb_usfm.zip, bsb_tables.xlsx and bsb.txt from bereanbible.com and of terms.htm and downloads.htm from berean.bible

coverage.scope: Protestant canon, 66 books, Old and New Testament
coverage.counting_rule: 66 .usfm files in bsb_usfm.zip (one \id per file); 31,086 \v markers in those files; bsb.txt holds 31,102 verse lines (bridged verses are one \v in USFM and separate lines in the text file)

license_files.says: Terms and Conditions, April 30, 2023: "The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially dedicated to the public domain as of April 30, 2023. All uses are freely permitted." and "For derivative works that vary from the official text, we respectfully request that the Berean name is not used."

flags.text: Berean name only on unaltered text: "All applications that maintain the verbatim text from the above Berean sites are invited to bear the Berean name. For derivative works that vary from the official text, we respectfully request that the Berean name is not used." (terms.htm, April 30, 2023). The translation lab (specs/19) renames any altered text.
flags.resolves_by: Policy already in specs/19; no research needed.

steward_proposal.rationale: Public-domain dedication by the rights holder on a dated terms page captured beside the bytes; the only condition is a naming request the project already honours.
steward_proposal.proposed_by: b003 agent (Claude Fable 5.1) for the source steward

notes: bsb.txt is UTF-8 with BOM and CRLF; bsb_usfm.zip entries are dated 2026-03-08 and carry "\id GEN Autogenerated BSB by bsb2usfm". The verse-count difference between the USFM and the text file is a bridging difference, not missing text.
